field_notes.team_monthly_stats.monthly_gate_revenue: Direct offset value; the revenue aggregation window has not been independently established. The legacy column name does not prove it is monthly revenue.
field_notes.season_rules: Configured and versioned rules, not observations of an in-game CBA ledger.
field_notes.monthly_snapshot: A capture label is not evidence that game results for a month were acquired. Game date comes from the player's explicit trigger.
field_notes.player_age: Observed birth date; exact age is calculated only with a player-confirmed game date. Unknown date leaves age NULL.
field_notes.season_statistics: Current indexed season totals from roster descriptors; per-game and shooting percentages are deterministic Python calculations, not monthly observations.
field_notes.overall_rating: NOT_OBSERVED. Player reported MC Haliburton displays locked 60 and Curry 96; these samples are discovery clues, not a complete memory data source.
field_notes.contract_ledger: Six 31-bit salary fields, options, contract type, duration and no-trade flags decoded. Guarantees, cap holds, exceptions and all CBA constraints are NOT_OBSERVED.
field_notes.staff_identity: Capture-local staff slot and reciprocal team-role links; not a cross-save permanent ID.
field_notes.player_pool_identity: Legacy model slot uses calibrated roster root as origin; slot zero is the roster directory. Read descriptor count plus root slot; never stop at a blank name.
